name: district-power-outage
description: A utility outage hits the Financial District during a full house. Emergency lighting only, elevators stopped.

ticks.narrative: 16:20 Main power lost across the floor; emergency lighting is on, elevators have stopped, AV and Wi-Fi are down. Building security says the utility reports an outage affecting several blocks of the Financial District with no restoration estimate. About 120 attendees are present: 90 in main_stage, 20 in the lounge, 10 at the catering_coffee_bar. Nobody is hurt. Stairwells are lit. Outside temperature is mild.
